note: AI-produced findings about B6 and their fate after GFL checked them. Each finding is a claim made by one model in one role; GFL's verdict comes from re-execution or from the data, never from the model's own confidence. Summaries are written by Claude (PM) and must pass tools/check_citations.py: every sentence cites register records, every cited record exists, and every number in a sentence appears in a cited record.
ranking_rule: Ranked by GFL's verdict after checking: upheld, then partly upheld, then not upheld, then fabricated; within a verdict, by date. A model's reputation, confidence or fluency does not enter the ranking.

verdicts.partly_upheld: part of the claim survived the check, part did not; both stated
verdicts.fabricated: the claim cites material the model never received, or reports output its code does not produce

label: AI-generated summaries; citations checked automatically; physics not validated by the check
checker: tools/check_citations.py (C1 every sentence cited, C2 cited records exist, C3 numbers appear in cited records)
